Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with live marketboard or Universalis data and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.75

- Batch listing and repricing collect pending price decisions into one scrollable panel per retainer, with editable prices, multiple selection, and a shared skip action.
- Added an end-of-run automation summary with phase timings, cache hits, listing/repricing totals, skipped-item reasons, and stopped-run details.
